name: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
header:
Institute of Science and Technology Austria
(ISTA)
Austria · Unified PhD programme with Mathematics track; direct bachelor’s entry
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Programme affiliation is chosen through rotations; a named professor is not guaranteed.
• Only live-portal-listed groups recruit in this cycle.
• Use three letters despite an inconsistent two-letter sentence in the manual.
• Current short answers include an ISTA-paper DOI and your own research contribution.
• Published salary is2026gross and paid14times, not 12.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A mathematics bachelor’s or master’s qualifies for application; a completed UChicago mathematics BA can
support direct PhD entry, subject to preparation, selection and degree completion. Applications are to the
unified programme; research fit with available groups is essential. The diploma does not name a subject
specialization. [a] [b]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Study current groups and programme rotations; choose relevant research areas and potential groups, obtain
three referees’ consent, prepare CV/SoP/transcripts and three short answers, then create/activate the
application account. Use a desktop browser and regularly monitored email. Only groups appearing in the live
portal are recruiting this cycle. [a] [c]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Prior contact/approval is unnecessary. Apply to the programme and nominate groups; affiliation occurs after
first-year rotations by mutual agreement. The 2027 page warns that professors absent from the portal are not
recruiting. Check Hausel, Browning and Kuperberg availability there; faculty website presence alone is
insufficient. [a] [b] [e]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Desktop browser only; email activation and login verification codes. Only portal applications/documents
accepted. PDF uploads≤39MB. Undo Submit permits editing before deadline but requires resubmission; referee
changes after invitations go through admissions. Do not create duplicate applications to correct mistakes. [a]
[b] [c]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Application/manual explicitly 2027 with8January applicant,12January referee,15April acceptance,15September
start. Salary table is explicitly 2026. [a] [c] [d]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Formal English test proof is not required. Written/spoken English competence is essential and assessed during
interviews. German is not required. [b]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No degree-specific waiver is necessary: ISTA does not require TOEFL/IELTS/CPE from applicants generally.
UChicago study supports English preparation, but does not remove the interview’s language assessment. [b]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE is not required; the FAQ does not distinguish General from Mathematics Subject GRE in this statement.
Valid existing results may be listed in additional information. No recommended-score threshold is published. [b]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Transcripts/score sheets and diplomas for every programme and all years, including current studies. Current
students provide latest results; a newly started programme with no results uses enrollment confirmation and
course schedule. English originals alone suffice; otherwise supply original plus English translation
(self-translation acceptable at application). PDF only, unencrypted/password-free, document assembly allowed,
maximum 39MB per upload; combine pages into one file. [a] [b] [c]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Transcripts must include all courses and corresponding grades. A course schedule is needed for a newly
started programme without results; no separate mathematics-course-list template appears. [a] [c]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No separate course-description/syllabus requirement is listed in the application checklist/manual. Extra
unsolicited syllabus upload permission is not established. [a] [c]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Conflict]
Enter exactly three referees; at least two should be academic/research, at most one from a nonacademic work
environment. The FAQ requires three submitted letters and will not allow more than three referees. A manual
completeness paragraph inconsistently says two; follow the repeated three-letter requirement and resolve with
admissions if one letter risks missing. [a] [b] [c]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No extra ordinary funding reference is required. Referees assess analytical ability, technical competence,
independence and commitment; the portal accepts its standardized questions or a PDF letter. External
fellowships may impose separate requirements. [a] [c] [d]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Saving details alone is not the described trigger. Save the application and select Contact referees to send early
invitations; otherwise first submission sends requests automatically. Each referee gets a unique link. [b] [c]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Not restricted to after submission: early requests are explicitly encouraged. You may submit before letters
arrive; their portal remains open until 12January 2027. [a] [b]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Account option See status of referees shows requested, reminded, or submitted; submitted means received.
Referees receive an automated thank-you email after actual submission, not merely saving. [b]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Once contacted, a referee’s details cannot be edited by the applicant. Ask admissions with applicationID and
full replacement details by 8January 2027 15:00CET. Reapplications require new requests and documents.
Whether already-submitted letters can be substantively replaced was not publicly resolved. Applicant-uploaded
confidential letters cause disqualification. [b] [c]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [2027 confirmed]
Required English PDF: educational background, research experience, relevant activities and skills. Ideally one
page; no more than three pages.39MB maximum, no password/encryption. [c]
Statement of purpose [2027 confirmed]
Required English PDF, preferably no more than two pages. Faithful paraphrase: explain preparation for
graduate research, past projects, motivation for ISTA, technical skills, relevant background, chosen groups and
research/career goals. This is explicitly not a research proposal. No font/margin rule published. ISTA expects
the applicant’s own voice and discourages generic AI-generated statements. [a] [c]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate required personal/background essay listed. Relevant background can be discussed in SoP;
additional mandatory short answers concern scientific fit and research. [a] [c]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required form research areas plus group preferences and SoP discussion. One short answer ranks up to three
relevant ISTA groups and explains fit, including alternatives if first choice cannot affiliate. FAQ separately
mentions three-to-five groups in the selector; follow each live field’s own instruction. [a] [b] [c]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No full research proposal required; the manual explicitly distinguishes SoP from a proposal. The short answers
evaluate research understanding and experience. [c]

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No separate thesis or writing-sample PDF requirement. A mandatory short answer describes the applicant’s
most meaningful research experience (which may be a thesis, seminar paper, essay or research paper),
methods, personal contribution, difficulties and outcomes. Paper upload/link permissions for an unsolicited
sample were not established. [a] [c]
Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate publications-list upload required in the public checklist. Relevant research achievements can go in
CV/additional-experience fields; use the specific paper DOI for the required ISTA-paper response, not an
unsolicited collection of papers. [a] [c]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate math-course essay. Transcripts/full course-and-grade information and, where needed, a current
course schedule supply this evidence. [a] [c]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate essay for standard employed PhD funding. External awards have their own requirements; they are
not conditions of initial funded admission. [d]
Other short answers / materials [Conflict]
Three mandatory scientific short answers (faithful paraphrase): (1) rank and justify up to three ISTA groups
suitable for affiliation; (2) identify an ISTA professor’s paper by DOI and explain why it excites you and what
you could contribute; (3) describe your most meaningful research experience, methods, contribution,
challenges and results. The admissions page says5-8lines maximum; manual says2-3short paragraphs. Use
concise answers satisfying both if possible and inspect portal limits. Additional optional fields record
internships, achievements and technical skills. [a] [c]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
All PhD students are employees with full social-security/health coverage and conference/workshop support.
Published 2026 gross monthly range€3,053-€3,673, paid14times/year (double paymentsJune/November).
Arithmetic annual gross€42,742-€51,422; rate depends on bachelor/master entry and qualifying-exam stage.
This is 2026, not a confirmed 2027 salary schedule. No tuition. [b] [d]
Years of support [Standing rule]
The programme normally lasts about five years, depending on progress/field; all PhD students are funded
employees. The public pages checked do not specify a universal maximum guaranteed employment term or
renewal clause - obtain that from the contract. [b] [d]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The programme recruits internationally and funds all admitted PhD students as employees. No nationality
restriction on ordinary salary is stated; Austrian visa/residence paperwork follows an offer. US F-1 status
provides no Austrian status. [a] [b] [d]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Before qualification students complete coursework and rotations; after qualification they research and may
assist teaching. A salary raise follows the qualifying exam, normally about1.5years into the degree. Group
affiliation requires successful rotation and mutual agreement; initial preference does not guarantee a
supervisor. [b] [d]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate standard funding application. External fellowships may be pursued with Grant Office support. [d]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Official examples include Austrian Academy DOC fellowships and research-group ERC/FWF support; other listed

awards may be discipline-specific. These supplement the institutional research environment and should not be
assumed to produce extra personal salary. [d]
Application fee [Standing rule]
No application fee and no tuition fee. [d]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Not applicable: application is free. [d]
